description: Tests for avoidance of self-loops when an entity is mentioned repeatedly in a single record. Robustness category K.

fixtures.input_condition: A single entity mentioned multiple times within the same record text without other entities

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Ravi Malhotra called Ravi Malhotra on another device.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Graph builder must not create a self-loop (an edge where source == target).
fixtures.rationale: Combinations(entities, 2) over de-duplicated entity sets within a record prevents self-pairings.
